name: Torchlight deals one Purity Flame amount amplified by the matching stacks (O-24)
contract: Purity & Wickedness 680544: "Torchlight can now consume these stacks to deal ${$681415m1+$681415ppl1+$sph*.25+$AP*.45} Holyflame or Shadowstrike damage to the target." Owner ruling O-24 and mentor D-159: a Torchlight 503662 hit on a target with any Purity 681413 or Wickedness 681523 stack consumes all stacks of both types and deals that amount once, as Holyflame 681415 or Shadowstrike 681524 chosen 50/50 whatever the types present, before the stacks are removed, so the matching stacks amplify it. Purity is aura 271 for Holy and Fire (MiscValue 6), Wickedness for Physical and Shadow (MiscValue 33), 2% per stack (EffectBasePoints 1 / DieSides 1), up to six; Holyflame is school 6 and Shadowstrike 33 after the load rewrite, so each type amplifies its own helper only. The hunter carries beeg spellpen 823764 (aura 123 -9999 target resistance for every magic school; its family 33 modifier does not reach family 21), a precondition fixture without which two Holyflame hits in three were partially resisted. Stacks are set with set_aura (precondition fixtures, caster the hunter) and mana is set to 500 (Torchlight costs 5% of base mana) before each Torchlight.

First, twenty Torchlights on Purity 6 + Wickedness 6: each removes both types, casts at most one Holyflame and at most one Shadowstrike, and the twenty together cast exactly twenty helpers (Holyflame count + Shadowstrike count, read as the Shadowstrike count relative to the negated Holyflame count, the negation being the hunter's Holyflame count on itself, 0, relative to the Holyflame count; both counts start at 0). Then six arms of sixty Torchlights with one type only, Wickedness 1, Purity 1, Wickedness 3, Purity 3, Wickedness 6, Purity 6, each ending with that type removed. Each arm's plain (non-critical, unresisted, unblocked) helper means are compared as ratios, so armor and the caster's stats cancel: the matching school over the other arm at the same stack count is 1 + 0.02 x stacks (1.02, 1.06, 1.12), the non-matching school is the same at 1, 3 and 6 stacks (no x stacks, no bonus from the other school), and the matching school grows as (1 + 0.02 n) / 1.02 against one stack. Band 0.005 on each ratio: the 13-value roll (sd 3.74 on about 1160) over at least 15 hits gives a ratio sd of at most 0.12%, so each band is above 4 sd (residual under 3e-5 per ratio, all ratios together under 5e-4). Each arm asserts at least 15 hits per school: residual 4.2e-5 per arm (Bin(60, 0.5) outside [15, 45]), 2.5e-4 for the six arms.
